title: Optimization of a methodology for speciation of arsenic, selenium and mercury in blood samples based on the deep eutectic solvent
author: Akramipour, Golpayegani, et al.

steps.title: Collect blood samples
steps.instruction: Obtain 1.0 ml of blood from each child and place it into a 10‑ml glass tube.

steps.title: Pre‑treat blood sample
steps.instruction: Add 600 µl acetonitrile and 900 µl of 15 % (w/v) ZnSO₄ to the tube, vortex for 5 min, keep at 5 °C for 10 min, centrifuge at 5000 rpm for 3 min, collect the supernatant, and dilute it with ultrapure water to a final volume of 10.0 ml.

substeps.instruction: Maintain the tube at 5 °C for 10 min.
Transfer the supernatant to a new tube.
Dilute with ultrapure water to 10.0 ml total volume.

steps.title: Perform LPME‑SDES extraction
steps.instruction: Place 10.0 ml of the prepared sample (ultrapure water or pre‑treated blood) into a 10‑ml test tube, inject 60 µl of the deep eutectic solvent (DES) containing 15.0 µl DDTP using a 100‑µl Gastight Hamilton syringe, vortex 5 min, centrifuge 4 min at 5000 rpm, solidify the floating DES in an ice bath for a few minutes, transfer the solidified DES to a conical vial, melt it immediately, add 20 µl acidic ethanol, and keep the solution ready for injection.

substeps.instruction: Add 10.0 ml of the sample to a 10‑ml test tube.
Inject 60 µl DES (containing 15.0 µl DDTP) with a 100‑µl Gastight Hamilton syringe.
Vortex the tube for 5 min to ensure contact.
Centrifuge for 4 min at 5000 rpm to separate phases.
Place the tube in an ice bath; allow the DES droplets to solidify (few minutes).
Transfer the solidified DES into a conical vial and melt it immediately.
Add 20 µl acidic ethanol to reduce viscosity.

steps.title: Inject extract into GFAAS
steps.instruction: Using the autosampler, inject 30.0 µl of the prepared extract into the graphite furnace atomic absorption spectrometer (GFAAS) and run the predefined temperature program.
